Scales the output dimensions by a factor. For example, a 1280x720px frame will become a 1920x1080px frame with a scale factor of `1.5`. See [Scaling](/docs/scaling) for more details.

## CLI flag

Use `--scale` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                 | Flag              |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                   | `--scale <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                   | `--scale <value>` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                     | `--scale <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)             | `--scale <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)     | `--scale <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)       | `--scale <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render) | `--scale <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)   | `--scale <value>` |

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#scale)
- [`renderStillOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/renderstilloncloudrun#scale)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#scale)
- [`renderStillOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/renderstillonlambda#scale)
- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#scale)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#scale)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#scale)
- [`canRenderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/can-render-media-on-web#scale)
- [`renderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-media-on-web#scale)
- [`renderStillOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-still-on-web#scale)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setScale(2);
```
